name: Montra
description: Montra turns narrated screen recordings into structured tickets with annotated screenshots and transcripts; this connector lets Claude browse your workspace's documents and tickets, pull the screenshots and transcripts behind each one, and create, update, link, and close tickets as it implements the work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Montra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Montra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://montra.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Montra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Montra lists 15 MCP tools, including create_document, create_ticket, delete_ticket, get_document, get_document_by_share_url, get_ticket, get_ticket_images, get_transcript, get_workspace, link_ticket_issue, list_documents, and list_folders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Montra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Montra in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Montra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Montra is developed by Montra. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
